Capacity ≈ stacks × dies per stack × GB per die Bandwidth ≈ stacks × interface width × pin speed Stack height buys capacity, not bandwidth. Cutting 12-Hi to 8-Hi drops a third of the DRAM dies, the most supply-constrained silicon on the BOM, while bandwidth holds or ticks up.
